Klasse HelpGridMap

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.graphics.HelpGridMap
public class HelpGridMap extends Object
Development utility that converts the visual JavaFX course into server-side data structures. Rasterizes obstacle shapes onto an 80x45 grid to produce terrain type maps, shape ID maps, and MapData.ServerShape definitions for the physics engine.
